verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Trigger.dev tasks are written as code in the user's own repo and can be deployed from GitHub Actions on push to main. Any versioning or review would therefore come from the user's own git workflow, a user-side workaround rather than a product feature. Prompt-template versioning (docs-41) is a different feature, and nothing documents task-version history, a review step, or rollback to a prior deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
